subject: c-cult-at
title: C.CULT.AT.-----RT.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 387 (R(AS)CM(II)-31). C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) is the subject; RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis), PART (participation) and SOC-RT (social reality). From CULT-INFO-B: MOT-DY and JR-DYM (journalism dynamics). From PART: OP-SD (option spread). From SOC-RT: UPB (underlying philosophical basis). From JR-DYM: IST-F (isolated focus). From OP-SD: POL-SIGN (political significance).
